title.provenance: NEW SECTION. Sec. 7. This chapter may be known and cited as the toxic-free cosmetics act.

location.provenance: State of Washington 68th Legislature 2023 Regular Session

reference.provenance: adding a new chapter to Title 70A RCW

status.provenance: AN ACT Relating to the use of toxic chemicals in cosmetic products

date.provenance: State of Washington 68th Legislature 2023 Regular Session

pfas_definition.provenance: Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances" has the same meaning as defined in RCW 70A.350.010.

type.provenance: beginning January 1, 2025, no person may manufacture, knowingly sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in this state any cosmetic product that contains any of the following intentionally added chemicals or chemical classes

who.provenance: no person may manufacture, knowingly sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in this state

action.provenance: no person may manufacture, knowingly sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in this state

products.provenance: any cosmetic product that contains any of the following intentionally added chemicals or chemical classes

value: cosmetic products do not include prescription drugs approved by the United States food and drug administration
ingredients regulated as drugs by the United States food and drug administration are not subject to the restrictions established in this section
exceptions.provenance: For the purposes of this section, cosmetic products do not include prescription drugs approved by the United States food and drug administration. For purposes of this section, ingredients regulated as drugs by the United States food and drug administration are not subject to the restrictions established in this section.
